subject: Minimum sample size with just 2 or 3 distance categories

messages.author: 9cfb65a737424404
messages.subject: Minimum sample size with just 2 or 3 distance categories
parts:
Hello,

Recommended minimum sample size for distance analysis is 60 detections
(or at least 40).

Large sample sizes are needed to produce detailed plots of detection
frequency.

If we have only two or three distance categories, do we still require
such large sample sizes?

Stephen.
